en.title: Silverton Mountain snow depth vs last winter: 31 in today, 0 in a year ago (US West, 11 November)
en.description: Is there more snow than a year ago? We compared today with 11 November last winter at 4 resorts in the US West: 4 of them have more snow now, …
en.lede: Is there more snow than a year ago? We compared today with 11 November last winter at 4 resorts in the US West: 4 of them have more snow now, according to our snow model. The biggest change is at Silverton Mountain: 31 in (79 cm) today against 0 in (0 cm) a year ago. Satellites never get tired, but they do get clouds.

p: Wolf Creek at 11,010 ft (3,356 m): 26 in (66 cm) now, more than the 0 in (0 cm) of 11 November last winter. Usual for the date: 8 in (20 cm).
Telluride, 10,620 ft (3,237 m): 8 in (20 cm) today, more than last winter's 0 in (0 cm) on 11 November. The usual value for this date: 9 in (24 cm).
Silverton Mountain at 10,643 ft (3,244 m): 31 in (79 cm) now, more than the 0 in (0 cm) of 11 November last winter. Usual for the date: 7 in (17 cm).
Purgatory Resort, 9,820 ft (2,993 m): 4 in (10 cm) today, more than last winter's 0 in (0 cm) on 11 November. The usual value for this date: 6 in (14 cm).
Measured: the Wolf Creek Summit station (10,928 ft (3,331 m), 2.0 km from Wolf Creek) reports 20 in (51 cm) today and had 1 in (3 cm) on 11 November last winter.
Measured: the Alta Lakes station (11,289 ft (3,441 m), 3.5 km from Telluride) reports 19 in (48 cm) today and had 3 in (8 cm) on 11 November last winter.
Measured: the Red Mountain Pass station (11,060 ft (3,371 m), 5.3 km from Silverton Mountain) reports 23 in (58 cm) today and had 0 in (0 cm) on 11 November last winter.
Measured: the Cascade #2 station (8,990 ft (2,740 m), 4.1 km from Purgatory Resort) reports 0 in (0 cm) today and had 0 in (0 cm) on 11 November last winter.
The Beartown station (11,581 ft (3,530 m)) measured 30 in (76 cm) on 10 November.
The Bison Lake station (10,951 ft (3,338 m)) measured 14 in (36 cm) on 10 November.
Our model's tally for Wolf Creek this winter: 1 days with a gain of 4 in (10 cm) or more, 0 days with a loss of 2 in (5 cm) or more to melt, rain or wind.
Telluride this winter: 0 days gaining 4 in (10 cm) or more, 0 days losing 2 in (5 cm) or more (melt, rain, wind).
Our model's tally for Silverton Mountain this winter: 1 days with a gain of 4 in (10 cm) or more, 0 days with a loss of 2 in (5 cm) or more to melt, rain or wind.
Early-season gaps are mostly noise: one storm more or less decides them, and they predict little about the rest of the winter.
Wolf Creek, last winter (2025-26): peak 30 in (76 cm) on 21 February, same height.
Telluride: the peak of last winter (2025-26) was 30 in (76 cm), on 21 February, at this height.
Silverton Mountain, last winter (2025-26): peak 20 in (51 cm) on 21 February, same height.

advice: A better start than last year is no promise for the holidays: watch the forecast, not only the snow already on the ground.
Model values describe an area at one height; a station measures one point. Read both before you decide.
Snow on the map does not mean a resort is open: check lifts and dates on the resort's website.
Before any off-piste or touring day, read the official avalanche bulletin (links below).

Telluride هاد الشتا: 0 أيام ربحو 4 إنش (10 سم) ولا كثر، 0 أيام خسرو 2 إنش (5 سم) ولا كثر (الذوبان، الشتا، الريح).
الحساب ديال الموديل ديالنا ل Silverton Mountain هاد الشتا: 1 أيام فيهم زيادة ديال 4 إنش (10 سم) ولا كثر، 0 أيام فيهم نقص ديال 2 إنش (5 سم) ولا كثر بالذوبان، الشتا ولا الريح.
الفروق ديال بداية الموسم أغلبها تشويش: عاصفة وحدة زايدة ولا ناقصة كتقررها، وماكتنبأش بزاف بالباقي ديال الشتا.
Wolf Creek، الشتا اللي فاتت (2025-26): القمة 30 إنش (76 سم) نهار 21 فبراير، نفس العلو.
Telluride: القمة ديال الشتا اللي فاتت (2025-26) كانت 30 إنش (76 سم)، نهار 21 فبراير، فهاد العلو.
Silverton Mountain، الشتا اللي فاتت (2025-26): القمة 20 إنش (51 سم) نهار 21 فبراير، نفس العلو.

advice: بداية أحسن من العام اللي فات ماشي ضمانة للعطلة: تبع التوقعات، ماشي غير التلج اللي كاين فالأرض.
الأرقام ديال الموديل كتوصف منطقة فعلو واحد؛ المحطة كتقيس نقطة وحدة. قرا بجوج قبل ما تقرر.
التلج فالخريطة ماكيعنيش بلي المحطة محلولة: شوف التيليسييج والتواريخ فالموقع ديالها.
قبل أي خرجة برا البيست ولا جولة، قرا النشرة الرسمية ديال الانهيارات (الروابط لتحت).
